name: eonik
official_name_basis: ChatGPTプラグイン詳細画面の表示名
original_description:
eonik is the research and the making of a brand's ads. Connect your eonik account, or make one, and ask in your own words.

Set eonik up from here: your brand from its website, the competitors you name, your team and your ad account. Then ask what your competitors are running, how long each ad has run and what changed this week, read scene-by-scene breakdowns, see your own Meta ad results, and have eonik remember your brand's rules and dated plans.

The making runs in the eonik app on your Mac, where your files and fonts are: every size of a creative for a media plan, with the brand's fonts, rules and layout kept, changes in your own words, checks against the brand's rules, your client's approval and delivery.

You review and confirm before anything is made, changed or sent. eonik reports recorded facts: it does not predict how an ad will perform, buys nothing, and cannot pause or launch an ad or change its budget.
